interpretation.proposed_segmentation: VORSTOSS D. [?] ABGESESSENEN 4./1. G. DRAG. STIESS WESTL. MIRCO AUF STAERKEREN GEGNER. MIRCO WURDE VOM GEGNER BESETZT.
interpretation.english_paraphrase: A proposed reading describes an advance by the dismounted 4th Squadron of the 1st Guard Dragoon Regiment, encountering stronger opposition west of an unidentified MIRCO, and reports MIRCO occupied by the enemy. The syntax immediately after D remains unresolved.

dismounted_word.implication: The apparent ESSEK substring can be internal to ABGESESSENEN. It does not justify treating Osijek as a source-forced place-name.

squadron_fragment.caveat: The unit expansion is contextual interpretation, not an observed long-form unit name.

interpretation.scope: Eight-substitution baseline; the separate nine-substitution full hypothesis reads DER in the remaining position.

source_audit.outcome: All nine source glyphs support the current literal transcription. There is no visual basis to relabel these proposed repairs as transcription corrections.

caveats: The exact roundtrips only certify what the proposed edits imply. They do not prove that the edits occurred.
The eight-substitution baseline fills twelve erasures; the nine-substitution full hypothesis fills thirteen. Every filling is conjectural.
The eight-substitution baseline retains six alternatives at plaintext index 10. The full hypothesis selects DER only after an additional known-coordinate substitution and erasure fill.

A separate full hypothesis adds one known-coordinate repair at source 179 and fills the final erasure at source 50 to read DER. Its exact roundtrip is conditional on all nine repairs and thirteen fills.
MIRCO remains unidentified. No change to MIROC, Mirkovci, Mirkovacz, Mitrowica, or a person is adopted.
